title: Measures to Prevent Medical and Dental Clinics from Over-provision of Services under Community Health Assist Scheme
what_it_is: Measures to Prevent Medical and Dental Clinics from Over-provision of Services under Community Health Assist Scheme

sections.label: CHAS claim audits and suspensions
sections.summary: Regular audits of CHAS claims check guideline compliance, complaints are investigated, and two clinics' CHAS participation was recently suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We also conduct regular audits of CHAS claims to ensure compliance with our guidelines and investigate complaints that we receive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We take a serious view of any errant practices and have recently suspended two clinics' participation in CHAS.

sections.label: Growth in CHAS clinics
sections.summary: CHAS clinics more than doubled over four years to about 1,600 island-wide, giving cardholders and Pioneers more choices than at launch.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: With the number of CHAS clinics more than doubled over the past four years to about 1,600 island-wide, CHAS cardholders and Pioneers have more choices now, compared to when the scheme was first launched.

sections.label: Clinics referred to police
sections.summary: Feedback is taken seriously but is small, suggesting most CHAS clinics charge reasonably; two suspended dental clinics and a couple more were referred to police.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: While we take such feedback very seriously, the small number suggests that the large majority of CHAS clinics continue to be reasonable in their charges.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: With regard to the Member's last question on the number of clinics being investigated, other than the two dental clinics which we have suspended CHAS accreditation and are currently being referred to the police for further investigation, there are just a couple more clinics that have been referred to the police for investigations.

sections.label: MOH audits and complaint handling
sections.summary: MOH regularly audits CHAS claims against guidelines, audits complained-about clinics in more detail, AIC explains misunderstandings, and misconduct leads to action.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: MOH conducts very regular audits on CHAS claims and we do look into the clinics' compliance according to the existing 	Page: 29 CHAS guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And if we do receive feedback or complaints from residents, then we will audit the clinic in even more detail to ascertain the rationale, as well as how the charges are being made.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: If there is any misunderstanding between the patients and the doctors, the Agency of Integrated Care (AIC) will then explain to the residents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But if we do find any misconduct, we will not hesitate to take action against the doctors.
